description: This Java class provides side-effect free methods for computing various summarized totals (such as deposits, withdrawals, interest, fees, penalties, overdraft interest, and withhold tax) based on a list of SavingsAccountTransaction objects, wrapping logic for calculating total amounts under different transaction types and conditions.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionSummaryWrapper
classes.description: A utility class for summarizing various transaction totals related to a SavingsAccount, focusing on calculations that do not cause side effects.

methods.name: calculateTotalDeposits
methods.description: Calculates the total deposit amount from a list of transactions, including dividends, excluding reversed transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalWithdrawals
methods.description: Calculates the total withdrawal amount from transactions, excluding reversed transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalInterestPosted
methods.description: Calculates total interest posted, excluding reversed transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalInterestPosted
methods.description: Calculates total interest posted, including a starting amount, then adding relevant transactions, excluding reversed transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalWithdrawalFees
methods.description: Calculates total withdrawal fees, excluding reversed transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalAnnualFees
methods.description: Calculates total annual fees, excluding reversed transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalFeesCharge
methods.description: Calculates total fees charges, excluding reversed transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalFeesChargeWaived
methods.description: Calculates total waived fee charges, excluding reversed transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalPenaltyCharge
methods.description: Calculates total penalty charges, excluding reversed transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalPenaltyChargeWaived
methods.description: Calculates total waived penalty charges, excluding reversed transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalOverdraftInterest
methods.description: Calculates total overdraft interest, starting from a provided amount, excluding reversed transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalOverdraftInterest
methods.description: Calculates total overdraft interest from transactions, starting with zero, excluding reversed transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalWithholdTaxWithdrawal
methods.description: Calculates total withhold tax from transactions, excluding reversed transactions.
